newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada plans US$1.0 bln global bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Canada plans US$1.0 bln global bond issue.

text.p: The Canadian government on Monday said it plans a global offering of US$1.0 billion of five-year bonds to help refinance its foreign exchange reserves.

The Finance Ministry said the bonds would be simultaneously distributed in Asia, Europe and North America. Merrill Lynch, Nesbitt Burns and Salomon Brothers will be the joint leads and bookrunners for the issue. The rest of the syndicate will comprise a group of Canadian and international firms.
"Favorable market conditions are providing an opportunity to refinance maturing liabilities in Canada's foreign exchange reserve portfolio," the Finance Ministry said in a statement.
The ministry said the offering was subject to market conditions.
Market sources said the global bond issue would be lauched tonight in Asian markets.
